look: Sathya's AI for Real Life collage reel series: white paper-texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spot / soft light; full-colour pop-art sticker cut-outs pinned with heavy soft drop shadows; brand accents pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD only; pro camera rig travelling a tall world with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins and whip cuts; Morven kicker over huge Allenoire headlines with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes, stamps and nodes, hand-drawn pink curves and chains, a ghost outline word behind every scene; AI for Real Life logo end card. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, cut to the 26 Nov 2026 agent-reliability script's timecodes, no voice-over, SFX-only score, text inside the Reels safe zone. rich

scenes.name: 95% becomes 36%
scenes.desc: Frame 0 mid-action: TWENTY STEPS over a calculator card typing 0.95 ^ 20 =, a typist hammering beside it; the result counts to 0.3585 and a pink stamp slams 36%.

scenes.name: One number on a slide
scenes.desc: A vendor deck panel shows one huge 95% ACCURATE badge with a dart planted in it; three tapes slam ONE TASK / ONE DEMO / ONE NUMBER, then the camera tilts down to HOW MANY STEPS, which nobody asks.

scenes.name: It multiplies
scenes.desc: Twenty pink links fill in across two rows; link seven goes grey and every link after it follows, under the headline IT MULTIPLIES.

scenes.name: Success = R to the N
scenes.desc: The formula builds: SUCCESS = R with a raised N, a pink and a blue node naming each term, a reliability gauge ticking beside it.

scenes.name: The curve
scenes.desc: A pink curve draws down a drawn axis as markers land at 5: 77%, 10: 60%, 20: 36% and 50: 8%, with dominoes toppling below it.

scenes.name: Nine models, 10,664 runs
scenes.desc: NINE MODELS over a counter climbing to 10,664 agent runs, a blue tape A GEOMETRIC LAW, then two nodes: step count kills you, not context length.

scenes.name: Run it backwards
scenes.desc: To clear 90% the per-step figure counts up to 99.5% beside a climbing ladder; the camera tilts down to two bars, 42% expect autonomy by 2030 against 5% with the controls today.

scenes.name: Put a checkpoint
scenes.desc: COUNT THE STEPS over a ten-link chain; a pink checkpoint flag drops onto the link where the curve crosses what you can afford to lose, a gavel landing beside it.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
